title: Daily briefing: Medicine Nobel prize goes to optogenetics
title_zh: 每日简报：医学诺贝尔奖授予光遗传学
abstract: Three pioneers of optogenetics have won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. Plus, the funniest nature photography and the physics behind a new science-fiction novel.
abstract_zh: 光遗传学的三位先驱获得了2026年生理学或医学诺贝尔奖。文章还介绍了最有趣的自然摄影以及一部新科幻小说背后的物理原理。
